integrity: The multiplication table, grading, twist, Rota–Baxter definition, averaging definition, centroid definition, and Nijenhuis definition were reconstructed from the public full text. The arbitrary-field claims follow from explicit basiswise polynomial reductions. Finite-field enumeration is used only as replay evidence.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns even operators on one two-dimensional Hom-associative color algebra.
An equivalent classification may exist under different Hom-color notation.
The journal-hosted full text of the primary paper was not retrievable during the literature check; the arXiv v1 full text was inspected.
title: Operator rigidity and parity splitting in a two-dimensional Hom-associative color algebra
